get_camera_params: get camera parameters for a BOP dataset like tless or ycbv by dataset name and camera type
get_model_params: get object model parameters including obj_ids and symmetric_obj_ids for a named BOP dataset
get_split_params: get dataset split parameters with scene_ids, image sizes, and path templates for a BOP dataset
scene_tpaths_keys: get template path keys for scene ground truth and camera files given an evaluation modality
get_present_scene_ids: get sorted scene IDs present in a dataset split by scanning the split directory
